title: What's in a name?
dek: 35,014 French commune names, from Y to Saint-Remy-en-Bouzemont-Saint-Genest-et-Isson.
summary: France's communes have one of the most extraordinary naming records in the world. There is exactly one commune with a single-letter name (Y, population 89). There are 13 two-letter communes. Sainte-Colombe is the most common name, shared by 12 separate places. And 3,898 communes — one in nine — start with Saint or Sainte.
